thread:
Samir (AE): Heads-up: NovumHealth POC ready to sign but procurement asks for UK-signed PoA + notarized addendum and remit-to details (Net45). Can we accept?

Tara (Legal): Do they require wet-ink notarization? We can accept DocuSign Notary or local e-notary. Wet-ink will slow it.

Linh (RevOps): Uploaded docs: https://drive.redwood/novum/poc_vendor_packet.pdf. PO entity = NovumHealth Ltd. PoA is scanned.

Novum Procurement Bot: Files: purchase_order_4312.pdf, power_of_attorney.pdf, remit_details_blank.docx uploaded by procurement@novumhealth.co.uk.

Mark (Finance): Net45 OK if bank beneficiary matches invoiced entity. Need IBAN/SWIFT and company tax id/VAT. If bank pays a different affiliate, require vendor change request.

Olivia (SE): They requested 99.95% SLA for Dedicated. We can offer it with committed capacity and an appendix; ops needs 48h to provision.

Samir (AE): PoA shows "Jonathan Meyers" while PO shows "J. Meyers". Procurement says that's fine. Legal/Finance: acceptable?

Tara (Legal): Prefer exact match. Options: corrected PoA, company letter confirming signatory, or registry extract. I'll add e-notary clause and PoA verification to redline.

Mark (Finance): Also require completed remit block on order form. Sample below for them to fill:

Remit-To: [Bank name]
Beneficiary: [Legal entity name]
IBAN/Account #: [IBAN]
SWIFT/BIC: [if needed]
Payment Terms: Net45

Samir (AE): I'll ask for corrected PoA or company letter, completed remit block, and if they accept e-notary. Sending redline now.

Novum Procurement Bot: Novum reply: "We will provide company letter and scanned notary-stamped PoA. E-notary acceptable if Redwood confirms."

Tara (Legal): Works. I'll produce MSA+Order Form+DPA redline with optional e-notary, PoA dated within 12 months or company letter, and SLA fallback credits.

Linh (RevOps): Billing needs beneficiary to match contract entity. Finance will validate bank before first invoice.

Samir (AE): Thanks — pushing redline and doc requests. Will update when cleared.
